audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart gives Fizz 6 of 7 stages and ends on 'Skill'; the packet and the content layer both give him 5 and hand the last two to Aurelion Sol. Rows 5 and 6 rendered different answers on the two layers.
audit.why: 45.38% over 877 games is a genuinely losing lane and the Fizz x5 early chart is right. The last two rows still belong to Aurelion Sol on range: Breath of Light reaches 750 against a 550 Urchin Strike, and the full layer's own whys for rows 5 and 6 already describe Aurelion Sol winning — only the side field disagreed.
audit.corrected: phases[5].side and phases[6].side set to Aurelion Sol to match win[5] and win[6]. Difficulty left at HARD 8/10 and tone at #ff5d6c — the win rate supports both.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and content late build Shadowflame/Stormsurge against the full layer's Rod of Ages / Archangel's / Liandry's / Rabadon's. The level-6 spike also never gave Chum the Waters' numbers.
audit.why: Chum the Waters is 1300 range on a 120s cooldown at rank 1 — it is LONGER than Aurelion Sol's own 1250 Falling Star, which is the reason level 6 is his window and not yours. The page said only 'guaranteed slow'.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, spikes[2].text, mid, late, breakdown.spikes realigned to Rod of Ages and to the real 1300/120s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction was nowhere on the page: BOTH Playful / Trickster and Chum the Waters carry the grounding flag, and Astral Flight is a movement ability. Grounded, Aurelion Sol's only escape does not fire at all.
audit.why: enemyKit E flags: dash, grounding, slow, untargetable, zone. enemyKit R flags: projectile, grounding, knockup, slow, revealsStealth, zone. ownerKit W is a flight. The page treated Playful / Trickster purely as an untargetable dodge — half the ability. It is also the reason 'save Astral Flight to escape his all-in' is bad advice as written: once he is on you it is already too late to fly.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[1].d, spikes[0].text, spikes[1].text, whys[4], early, mid and wants.you[1] all now state the grounding.
sources: enemyKit E and R grounding flags
ownerKit W text — Aurelion Sol flies over terrain

audit.whatIsWrong: Fizz's passive was never mentioned: he moves through units and takes a flat amount of reduced damage from all sources.
audit.why: Both halves matter here. Walking through units means a shoved wave gives him free approach angles, and flat damage reduction is worst against exactly the chip pattern Aurelion Sol farms with — a per-second beam tick. It is also why stacked stardust matters more in this matchup than in most.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early, dontsFull[2].d, spikes[2].text, spikes[3].text and late now use it.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Playful/Trickster resets' in spikes[2] and 'dash resets' in whys[2].
audit.why: Nothing in Fizz's kit resets. Playful / Trickster is a flat 16s at rank 1 down to 8s at rank 5; Urchin Strike is 8s down to 6s. Calling them resets tells the reader the window never opens, when in fact it opens on a timer they can count.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten with the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Voice of Light' used as an Aurelion Sol ability in spikes[3] and content late.
audit.why: Not in the kit — Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), the black hole (E), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (R).
audit.corrected: Replaced with Breath of Light and Falling Star.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (defect-catalogue item 3), and the packet flags 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.why: The whole matchup is a timer: you may channel Q only once Playful / Trickster is spent, and it is spent for 16 seconds at rank 1 but only 8 at rank 5.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Playful / Trickster 16s->8s, Chum the Waters 120s at 1300, Urchin Strike 8s, with an explicit 'wait for it before you channel Q' line. dosFull[2].d, breakdown.wave, breakdown.feeding and ahead add further sequencing.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were copy-paste bleed — tradeGood and tradeBad pasted under 'Hold Flash + R as a paired dive answer' and 'Contest his shove pre-item spike'.
audit.why: The titles promise the R/Flash rule and the shove-contest rule; the bodies explained the W flyby and the Q channel instead.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d rewritten around the untargetable window eating a spent Falling Star; dontsFull[2].d around his passive walking through the wave.

edits.after: Full-build Aurelion Sol out-ranges him entirely — Breath of Light burns him at 750 before Urchin Strike covers its 550, Falling Star stuns from 1250, and permanent stardust beats his flat damage reduction.

edits.before: Fizz's untargetable dash trivializes your zone control, letting him jump in, land Seastone Trident, and hop back out before you can punish with Q. Play with maximum spacing, don't commit Astral Flight early, and expect every trade near minions to favor his all-in over your poke.
edits.after: Playful / Trickster is 16s at rank 1 and it does two things at once: he is untargetable, and you are grounded, so Astral Flight will not fire while it is on you. Farm the back line with Q from 750, clear with E at 12s, and never trade near minions his passive lets him walk straight through.

edits.before: Level 6 Chum the Waters is close to a guaranteed slow, and the follow-up combo threatens a full kill before your own damage output can answer — this is one of the hardest all-in windows you face as Aurelion Sol. Play for survival and vision on his jungler rather than forcing skirmishes until you've banked your first item.
edits.after: Chum the Waters at 6 is 1300 range, longer than your own 1250 R, and it grounds, slows and knocks up — your channel ends and Astral Flight will not answer. It is 120 seconds at rank 1, so the window between casts is your whole lane. Play for survival and vision until Rod of Ages is fully banked.

edits.before: Once your core item completes, your range and burst finally out-scale his short-range dive kit — Voice of Light punishes his approach before Playful/Trickster gets him in range, and Q collision out-damages anything he lands in one combo. From here you control the poke war and he has to commit hard to threaten you at all.
edits.after: Once Rod of Ages and Archangel's are done, your range decides it — Breath of Light burns him at 750 before Urchin Strike covers 550, and Falling Star stuns from 1250 the instant he lands out of the hop. From here he has to commit through the black hole, and his flat damage reduction stops mattering against stacked stardust.

notes: The packet's suspectName on 'Land Chum the Waters' is a false positive — that is Fizz's real R name. The biggest defect on this page was not a wrong name but a missing half of an ability: Playful / Trickster and Chum the Waters BOTH ground, and Aurelion Sol's Astral Flight is a movement ability, so his only escape is switched off by the two abilities the matchup is built around. Every 'save W to escape his all-in' line on the page was therefore advice that cannot be followed once he commits — I rewrote wants.you[1] to say fly BEFORE the hop, not after. Full and content charts disagreed on rows 5 and 6 before this edit; both now read Fizz x5 / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol, matching the packet. Difficulty deliberately left at HARD 8/10 here — 45.38% is the one win rate in my slice that genuinely earns it.
